Subject: [MM-LAB-001] Complete Procure-to-Pay
Description:
**LAB ID:** MM-LAB-001

**Title:** Complete Procure-to-Pay

**Objective:** Execute the business process - Complete Procure-to-Pay - and validate documents, stock and accounting.

**Business Scenario:** A manufacturing company requires raw material from an approved supplier. This first run follows the instructor's step sheet in the prepared organization so that the whole flow is seen once before each part is studied.

**Prerequisites:** EX-005

**Required Configuration:** Prepared by the instructor: plant, storage location, purchasing organization and group, open posting period, account determination

**Master Data:** One raw material and one supplier, created by the student from the step sheet

**Transaction codes:** MM01; BP; ME51N; ME21N; MIGO; MIRO; FB03 (SAP GUI; use the Fiori app for the same function where one exists)

**Fiori apps:** My Home; App Finder; Manage Purchase Orders; Stock - Single Material

### Procedure
- [ ] Create the raw material with purchasing and accounting views
- [ ] Create the supplier as a business partner
- [ ] Create a purchase requisition
- [ ] Convert it to a purchase order
- [ ] Post the goods receipt
- [ ] Post the invoice receipt
- [ ] Display the purchase order history, the material document and both accounting documents

### Expected Result
- Purchase order history shows goods receipt and invoice
- Stock increased by the received quantity
- Two accounting documents exist

**Accounting Impact:** Goods receipt: inventory debit, GR/IR clearing credit. Invoice: GR/IR clearing debit, input tax debit, supplier credit.

**Integration Impact:** MM to FI through the material and invoice documents

**Troubleshooting:** Read the full message with its number. Check master data, then configuration, then authorization, then integration. Record each error and its cause in your issue log. If stuck for more than 30 minutes, set the status to Blocked and describe the blocker.

**Validation:** Display the documents created (purchasing document history, material document, accounting document, stock) and compare them with the expected result.

**Evidence:** Document numbers + screenshots

**Deliverable:** Step sheet with all document numbers

**Assessment:** Instructor verifies the expected result from the documents and may ask for a live demonstration.

### Completion criteria
- Every step is done and the expected result is demonstrated
- Evidence is attached to the issue and the deliverable is in your workbook or document set
- Accounting and integration impact are written down where documents were created
- Actual time is logged against the issue
- Instructor Review is Approved and the status is Completed

**Estimated time:** 4 h
